reviews.title: Quiet and seem to work well.
reviews.comment:
I purchased these for an 18-year-old CoolerMaster Praetorian case that has four 80mm fans.  The fans seem to need replacing every 5 years or so.  There are a lot of really good fans available, but if I had to pay $60 to $70 for fans, I'd put the money into a new case with modern features.
I don't know anything about the Arctic brand, but these fans work as good as the previous fans I had which were Enermax Marathon.  These fans are quiet and I've had no issues with overheating,  I game on this system and it has an i9-12900K and Arc A770.  If the fans last 5 years, they'll outlast the useful life of this system.
The "PWM sharing" feature is just marketing for a built-in Y-connector that lets you daisy-chain fans together.  It did allow me to remove a separate Y-connector from my PC, so I guess it was useful.
reviews.author: Brianosaurus

reviews.title: Artic P8 PWM fans
reviews.comment: Not bad for a 5 pack of these fans. I'm using two in my Nas case. These are just the right amount of air and noise. Not too noisy but keeps my 8 drive Nas cool at full speed.
reviews.author: Admin

reviews.title: They work well
reviews.comment: It works well, not too loud unless you crank up the RPMs, but the kit is good. If you have a small ITX or M-ATX case, it's ideal.
reviews.author: Oscar Li

reviews.title: They don't blow as hard as my old ones but....
reviews.comment: Tbh they make almost no noise, like at all, unless you crank them. They don't have the best flow rate, but tbh they are for extra GPU intake fans so I didn't need a lot.. Not quite as silent as my "no sound" 140 mm fans in my other case but they work.
reviews.author: tony iszler

reviews.title: Just perfect for a price
reviews.comment: One of the best fans available at an incredibly affordable price. The building quality is of the highest standard, which is always a plus. The fans are incredibly silent and perfectly fit for a low-noise system. Overall, they provide excellent performance.
reviews.author: Nikolay
